limits: Saved evidence only; no new request or retry was made.
A passing observation is not an availability, freshness or root-cause guarantee.
Evidence pointers refer to the original input document.
Saved evidence only; no DNS, request, retry or redirect was performed.
A captured terminal response may still fail status, body or JSON expectations.
An origin change is a review point, not proof of danger or failure.
Exact URL loops only; aliases and equivalent URL spellings are not inferred.
Input is not authenticated; evidence pointers refer to the original report.
Saved header hints only; no network, waiting, scheduling or retries.
An elapsed hint does not establish health or permission to retry.
Delay-seconds start at recorded receipt; HTTP dates use the local recorded clock.
Clock skew and transit/cache age are not corrected or inferred.
Only IMF-fixdate dates are supported; malformed/obsolete values remain unknown.
Old reports without retry_after cannot establish header absence.
Status context alone does not establish the cause or scope of a failure.
Reports are unauthenticated; only fields relevant to this analysis are validated.

result.scope: Freshness metadata only; not permission to store or reuse a response. Request directives, Vary matching, authorization, cache keys and stale extensions are not evaluated. No conditional request is sent.

limits: Observed health covers only the captured probe and its requested checks.
Supplemental lens availability is separate from observed HTTP health.
Default cache/retry arithmetic uses historical header receipt, not the current time.
Available means the lens ran, not that all evidence is known or authenticated.
No retry, wait, TLS-only follow-up, repair or conditional request is performed.
Saved evidence is unauthenticated; lens evidence pointers address source, not this wrapper.
